Pixel Pandit Photography — Wedding & Pre-Wedding Shoots, Delhi-NCR

Pixel Pandit is a Delhi-NCR photography studio known for vibrant, high-contrast
wedding albums and elaborate pre-wedding concept shoots (themed sets, costume
changes, location scouting across Rajasthan and Himachal).

Pricing: their 2021 rate card advertised a full wedding package at ₹95,000. A
2024 social-media post mentions packages "now starting at ₹1,40,000," while the
contact form auto-reply still quotes the older ₹95,000 figure. There is no
single current price stated clearly, so confirm the exact rate in writing before
booking.

Contact: +91 99580 22119 · studio@pixelpandit.example
Location: Sector 29, Gurugram, Haryana
Rating: 4.4 / 5 (181 reviews)

What couples say:
"Loved the pre-wedding concept shoot — super creative team."
"Editing is bold and colorful, exactly our vibe."

Pixel Pandit offers flexible add-ons (extra reels, second-day coverage) and is a
